subject: Integration Sprint: Marketplace Connector & SI Lab — calendar options
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@marketplace-inc.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.io
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace connector deep-dive / SI lab — proposed windows

Ben — thanks again for the product overview last week. CloudBridge’s marketplace team and our SI partner would like to run a joint integration sprint + technical deep-dive so we can: 
- validate connector architecture end-to-end
- confirm deployment patterns for marketplace listing (private/public)
- run a small SI lab to exercise onboarding and auth flows

Proposed days (US/PST):
- Tue Jul 20 — 10:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed Jul 21 — 09:00–12:00 (preferred by some of our infra folks)
- Thu Jul 22 — 13:00–16:00

High-level ask: can Redwood cover a runtime/ops lead + an engineer who owns KV/caching details? We’d like your input on what environment you need for the lab (test tenant, metrics/endpoints). I attached a very rough diagram (high-level-arch.png) to orient the team.

If you can share your availability over the three days I’ll pin down times and send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Partner PM — Marketplace Integrations
Marketplace, Inc.

Attachment: high-level-arch.png (image/png, 420 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@marketplace-inc.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace connector deep-dive / SI lab — proposed windows

Alyssa — appreciate the clear asks and the diagram. Camila (APIs/connector) and Sergio (infra/runtime) are looped in — tagging them to confirm technical coverage and preferred slots.

Quick notes from my side:
- We can staff a runtime lead + one engineer for KV/cache and one for auth flows.
- For the lab: ideally a sandbox tenant with service account keys and a test dataset (small).
- If Wed Jul 21 09:00–12:00 works for CloudBridge, that fits our schedules best. Otherwise Tue Jul 20 early afternoon is possible.

I attached a draft agenda (proposed-agenda.md); Camila/Sergio, can you review and update with any must-have checkpoints?

I’ll wait for your confirmations and then lock the invite.

—
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: proposed-agenda.md (text/markdown, 6 KB)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@marketplace-inc.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace connector deep-dive / SI lab — proposed windows

On Sun, Jul 12, 2026 at 9:05 AM Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@marketplace-inc.com> wrote:
> Ben — thanks again for the product overview last week. CloudBridge’s marketplace team and our SI partner would like to run a joint integration sprint + technical deep-dive so we can:
> - validate connector architecture end-to-end
> - confirm deployment patterns for marketplace listing (private/public)
> - run a small SI lab to exercise onboarding and auth flows
>
Thanks Alyssa — happy to help. A few technical constraints / asks up front:
- For a conclusive KV/cache exercise we need sample tokenized sequences or a small prompt set (<= 10k tokens total) to exercise prefix caching; this avoids noisy perf results.
- If you want us to demo quantized model behavior in the lab, we’ll need to provision a GPU-backed sandbox (I can bring 1 medium GPU).
- Please share the test tenant service-account via a secure link (do not send creds in-line).

Agenda suggestion (short):
1) 09:00–09:20 — Introductions & scope
2) 09:20–10:00 — Architecture walkthrough (Camila)
3) 10:00–11:00 — Lab: onboarding + auth flows (hands on)
4) 11:00–11:30 — Perf validation & caching notes (Sergio)
5) 11:30–12:00 — Next steps / roll to marketplace listing

I moved Wed Jul 21 -> preferred as Ben suggested. If that’s confirmed I’ll prepare the SOW extract (internal draft) and a small checklist. Attaching a working SOW snapshot for internal review (SOW-draft-v0.3.pdf).

—
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Attachment: SOW-draft-v0.3.pdf (application/pdf, 120 KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@marketplace-inc.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace connector deep-dive / SI lab — proposed windows

On Sun, Jul 12, 2026 at 12:30 PM Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Agenda suggestion (short):
> 1) 09:00–09:20 — Introductions & scope
> 2) 09:20–10:00 — Architecture walkthrough (Camila)
> 3) 10:00–11:00 — Lab: onboarding + auth flows (hands on)
> 4) 11:00–11:30 — Perf validation & caching notes (Sergio)
> 5) 11:30–12:00 — Next steps / roll to marketplace listing

Thanks — this looks good. Two operational notes from infra:
- Recommend 3 hours booked (09:00–12:30) to allow a 30m buffer for setup/troubleshooting; I can onboard the env in first 20 minutes if we have the test tenant ready.
- For the perf segment we should capture the following metrics: p50/p95 latency, GPU mem utilization, and token cost per request. I’ll bring a small runbook.

If everyone is happy I support Wed Jul 21 09:00–12:30 (Redwood side) — please confirm final attendee list and we’ll create the sandbox and a short runbook doc.

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@marketplace-inc.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, partners@cloudbridge.io
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace connector deep-dive / SI lab — proposed windows

Alyssa — thanks for moving quickly and for the diagram. Confirming Wed Jul 21, 09:00–12:30 PDT for the integration sprint and deep-dive. I created a calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-integration-sprint (please accept).

Final attendee plan (Redwood):
- Ben Carter — sales / TL liaison
- Camila Reyes — solutions engineer (architecture & connector)
- Sergio Alvarez — infra/runtime (perf & KV caching)

CloudBridge / SI: please share the test tenant service-account and any sample prompts via a secure file share (we prefer the Confluence secure upload or a signed / expiring link). Do not send secrets over email.

Next steps: 
- Alyssa/CloudBridge to confirm SI attendee list and upload test data (by Tue Jul 20 EOD).
- Camila to publish short runbook and minimal checklist in Confluence (link below).
- Sergio to provision sandbox GPU + runbook on Jul 20.

Attachments: proposed-agenda.md
Related: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/CloudBridge+Integration+Spec

Thanks — see you Wednesday.

—
